item.title: Tecnologo: Multidisciplinary data collection and processing for the environmental management of Mediterranean microtidal beaches (Univ. CAGLIARI)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-17 23:59
Institution: Univ. CAGLIARI, Cagliari

The technologist will be involved in the acquisition, processing, and management of topographic, aerial photogrammetric, hydroacoustic, sedimentological, geomorphological, and coastal video-monitoring data for the management and monitoring of Mediterranean microtidal beaches. The technologist will also be involved in the setup and ongoing maintenance of digital databases, as well as the updating and management of data for the early warning system for coastal flooding and the forecasting of marine risks from storm surges and rip currents.

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Postdoctoral assignment - Stronger Together: The Role of Connectivity in Safeguarding Functioning Coastal Ecosystems under Global Change (Univ. VENEZIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2027-01-15 13:00
Institution: Univ. VENEZIA, Venice
Field: Earth sciences / 04/GEOS-03 Geografia fisica, geomorfologia e geologia applicata

Bathymetric and coastal habitat mapping in selected study areas in Fiji, the Seychelles, and Belize, integrating remote sensing techniques (e.g., Satellite-Derived Bathymetry) with direct field-based surveys. Investigation of wave attenuation by mangroves, coral reefs, and seagrass meadows through a combination of hydrodynamic modelling and field observations. Development and implementation of numerical hydrodynamic models using XBeach, forced with measured boundary conditions and future climate scenarios.

item.description:

Field: Earth sciences / 04/GEOS-02 Paleontologia, geologia stratigrafica e sedimentologia, geologia strutturale e tettonica

item.description:

item.title: Incarico post-doc: ncarico Post-Doc - GEOS-01/C - Effects of saltwater intrusion on mercury mobility in coastal contaminated soils (Univ. TRIESTE)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-10 23:59
Institution: Univ. TRIESTE, Trieste
Field: Earth sciences / 04/GEOS-01 Mineralogia, petrologia, geochimica, vulcanologia, georisorse e applicazioni

The candidate will investigate the effects of salinity variations on mercury mobility in coastal groundwater. Specifically, the research activities will involve groundwater monitoring with recording of physico-chemical parameters and the execution of related compositional and speciation analyses on groundwater and soil, along with the investigation of the biogeochemical processes regulating mercury mobility under different salinity conditions, in support of the definition of environmental management strategies. The post-doctoral researcher will contribute to third-mission activities and to teaching activities within Bachelor and/or Master degree programs, as well as to laboratory activities…
